principles: preserve source artwork, provenance, useful mappings, saves, tests and deterministic evidence
replace fragmented provider-specific runtime authority rather than rewriting providers in place
editor and client consume the same production resolvers and resolved draw plan
renderer consumes answers; it does not infer terrain topology or asset semantics
validators verify authored/runtime outputs; they never repair or choose replacement artwork
providerPolicy: V7, ElizaWy, LPC/OGA and Havenwild-original are provenance/providers only after publication; gameplay/editor semantics never branch on provider.
failurePolicy: Exact authored recipe first; explicitly approved composition second; otherwise structured unresolved diagnostic. Never fabricate proxy art.
